title: Authority instance narrows, never expands: a superset of the framework floor at the pinned revision; no downgrade acknowledgement for instances; authority.status derived from a valid charter
decided_at_provenance: RECORDED AT DECISION TIME. The agent posted the reading as an AGREE/NOT_AGREE packet in session; the operator replied 'Proceed on your call' (2026-08-28). This record is a DELEGATED decision: the content is the agent's proposed reading, the authority is the operator's explicit delegation, quoted verbatim. It is not a packet-level AGREE and is labelled so.

options_considered.A: charter = superset of the pinned floor (roles per class, reserved actions, human-reserved roles); no instance ack path; status derived -- SELECTED by delegation
options_considered.B: charter may relax the floor with a human declaration -- REJECTED: the framework's own matrix already needs a decision record + ack for a downgrade; an instance must not have an easier path than the framework
options_considered.C: no instance charter; projects judged against the framework HEAD matrix only -- REJECTED: the instance pins a framework revision for everything else; authority cannot be the one thing that floats

authorizes.summary: badf/authority/charter.json in the instance, generated by `charter <path>` as floor = ceiling and validated by `instance` against the framework matrix at the instance's pinned framework_revision using the framework's own downgrade comparison. Strengthening only.
excluded: no change to the framework's badf/authority-matrix.json or its monotonic guard semantics
no human declaration required to narrow (adding constraints is strengthening)
no re-pin / framework upgrade path (later WP)

proven_defect: On main dd1f897 an instance's authority.status is UNRESOLVED by construction and can never resolve; project dossiers are judged against the framework HEAD matrix, not the revision the instance pins.
residual_risk: A charter is self-declared text like every governance file; the lockfile makes an edit visible and the floor comparison makes a weakening refused. It cannot make a false narrowing (a role nobody holds) meaningful -- that is a human review concern at dossier time.

authority_downgrade.note: Strengthening only. An instance can only add constraints; there is no acknowledgement path that admits an instance below the floor.

binding.binding_note: filled by reconciliation when BADF-WP-0023 lands.

invalidation: Admitting any instance below the framework floor, or any acknowledgement path for instances, invalidates this decision; a new decision is required.
